subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 9: Get ready for … Pre A1 Starters
outcomes: I can read sentences and put a tick or a cross.
I can complete sentences from a picture with one word.
I can answer questions about me: What do you want to be?

tf.s: In Reading and Writing Part 1, you put a tick for a correct sentence.
tf.why: Yes! A tick means the sentence matches the picture.

tf.s: You mark a wrong sentence with a tick.
tf.why: We mark a wrong sentence with a cross.

tf.s: For 'She goes to work by car', you check the person and the transport.
tf.why: Great! Check she and car in the picture.

tf.s: Picture: a man on a train. 'She goes to work by train.' gets a tick.
tf.why: It's a man, so it gets a cross: He goes to work by train.

tf.s: In Part 5, you write one word in each gap.
tf.why: Right! One word in each sentence.

tf.s: Thought bubbles in the picture show dream jobs.
tf.why: Yes! The bubbles show what people want to be.

tf.s: We write: I want to be a artist.
tf.why: We write: I want to be an artist.

tf.s: A bubble with a fire helmet shows a firefighter.
tf.why: Well done! A fire helmet means firefighter.

tf.s: You don't need to check spelling before you finish.
tf.why: Always check your spelling and a / an.

tf.s: A bubble with space shows a chef.

boxes.q: How do you mark a wrong sentence?
boxes.why: A wrong sentence gets a cross.

boxes.q: Correct: She goes to work by train. (picture: a man)
o: He goes to work by train.
She go to work by train.
He goes to work by a train.

boxes.q: Complete: I want to be an ___. (bubble: space)
Complete: He goes to work by ___. (a man on a red motorbike)
Complete: She goes to work by ___. (a woman at the station steps)
boxes.why: Station steps go down to the underground.

boxes.q: Answer: What do you want to be?
o: I want to be a pilot.
boxes.why: We say: I want to be …

boxes.q: Answer: How do you go to school?
o: I go to school by bus.
I goes to school by bus.
boxes.why: We say: I go to school by bus.

boxes.q: How many words do you write in each gap in Part 5?
What shows a person's dream job in the picture?

boxes.why: artist starts with a vowel sound.

hunt.q: Man on a red motorbike: by …

mcq.q: What do you put next to a correct sentence in Part 1?
mcq.why: A correct sentence gets a tick.

mcq.q: Which question is about you in Speaking Part 4?
o: What do you want to be?

mcq.q: In the picture, what do the thought bubbles show?
Which word completes: I want to be an ___?
mcq.why: astronaut starts with a vowel sound.

mcq.q: Picture: a man on a train. Sentence: She goes to work by train. What do you do?
mcq.why: The person is a man, so it's wrong: a cross.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: She goes to work by train. (picture: a man)
o: He goes to work by train.
She goes to work by car.
He go to work by train.
He goes to work by a train.
mcq.why: A man is He. He goes to work by train.

mcq.q: Complete: I want to be a ___. (bubble: fire helmet)
Why is the answer an artist and not a artist?
o: artist starts with a vowel sound.
mcq.why: We use an before a vowel sound.

mcq.q: What do you check for: He goes to work by motorbike?
mcq.why: Check he and motorbike in the picture.

mcq.q: What should you do before you finish Part 5?
o: Write two words in each gap.
mcq.why: Checking helps you get every answer right.
